sql: SELECT "year", "month", data_value, predicted_value, percent_complete FROM health.cdc_state_drug_overdose_deaths WHERE state='US' AND indicator='Number of Drug Overdose Deaths' AND "year" IN ('2024','2025','2026') ORDER BY "year", CASE "month" WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 ELSE 12 END

SELECT indicator, "year", "month", data_value, predicted_value FROM health.cdc_state_drug_overdose_deaths WHERE state='US' AND indicator<>'Number of Drug Overdose Deaths' AND (("year"='2026' AND "month"='June') OR ("year"='2025' AND "month"='June')) ORDER BY indicator, "year"

SELECT "year", "month", data_value, predicted_value FROM health.cdc_state_drug_overdose_deaths WHERE state='US' AND indicator='Number of Drug Overdose Deaths' AND (("year" IN ('2016','2017','2022','2023')) OR ("year"='2021' AND "month" IN ('December')) ) ORDER BY "year", CASE "month" WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 ELSE 12 END

sql: SELECT "year","month",indicator,data_value,predicted_value FROM health.cdc_state_drug_overdose_deaths WHERE state='US' AND indicator='Number of Drug Overdose Deaths' AND ("year" IN ('2025','2026') OR ("year"='2023') OR ("year"='2024' AND month IN ('June','July','August','September','December'))) ORDER BY "year", CASE month WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 ELSE 12 END

SELECT indicator, MAX(CASE WHEN "year"='2026' THEN predicted_value END) p26, MAX(CASE WHEN "year"='2025' THEN predicted_value END) p25, MAX(CASE WHEN "year"='2026' THEN data_value END) r26, MAX(CASE WHEN "year"='2025' THEN data_value END) r25 FROM health.cdc_state_drug_overdose_deaths WHERE state='US' AND month='June' AND "year" IN ('2025','2026') GROUP BY indicator ORDER BY indicator

SELECT "year","month",predicted_value FROM health.cdc_state_drug_overdose_deaths WHERE state='US' AND indicator='Number of Drug Overdose Deaths' AND "year" IN ('2015','2016','2017') AND predicted_value<70000 ORDER BY "year", CASE month WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 ELSE 12 END

SELECT MAX(predicted_value) mx, MIN(predicted_value) FILTER (WHERE "year" IN ('2023','2024','2025','2026')) mn FROM health.cdc_state_drug_overdose_deaths WHERE state='US' AND indicator='Number of Drug Overdose Deaths'
